# mooncake mod add

Fetch a module and add it to the playbook's modules: block

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--as` | string | - | Override the default alias (taken from the module's name: field) |
| `--playbook` | string | - | Path to the mooncake.yml to update (default: ./mooncake.yml) |
